LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_HardyLabor.degreeDatas.0.desc: {PAWN_nameDef} can take hardship and works diligently, even at demanding tasks.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_FamineFarmer.degreeDatas.0.de: {PAWN_nameDef} knows field work well, from planting to harvesting.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_FieldGleaner.degreeDatas.0.de: {PAWN_nameDef} once lived by picking through forgotten corners and waste ground for anything edible. Now it is second nature.
{PAWN_nameDef} is good at looking after livestock, with a knack for taming and training animals.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_WellBearer.degreeDatas.0.desc: {PAWN_nameDef} knows how to carry things with less trouble and less effort. Asked for a lesson, {PAWN_nameDef} always says it comes naturally and cannot be taught.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_MoldSifter.degreeDatas.0.desc: {PAWN_nameDef} knows the smell of grain well and makes quick work of sorting it, preparing ingredients, and cooking.
{PAWN_nameDef} is handy with jobs like fixing roofs and patching wooden frames.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_RagTailor.degreeDatas.0.label: handy
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_RagTailor.degreeDatas.0.descr: {PAWN_nameDef} is good at stitching rags and old felt into something usable.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_HerbReader.degreeDatas.0.desc: {PAWN_nameDef} recognizes common medicinal herbs and is quick with a bandage.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_NightFugitive.degreeDatas.0.d: {PAWN_nameDef} is used to treading quietly at night, but always finds daylight a little too bright.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_SnowGuide.degreeDatas.0.label: good sense of direction
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_SnowGuide.degreeDatas.0.descr: {PAWN_nameDef} remembers familiar trails and can often find the way even after snow has covered the tracks.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_DustBearer.degreeDatas.0.desc: {PAWN_nameDef} wants to carry grain and water all the way to the next camp with food. Putting the load down is hard when it might mean having to ask for help again.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_CampWatcher.degreeDatas.0.des: {PAWN_nameDef} rarely panics when something unexpected happens and can hold it together under strain. People sometimes joke that {PAWN_pronoun} is a tightly wound bomb.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_AlmsSpeaker.degreeDatas.0.des: {PAWN_nameDef} has a way with words. Even the hardest thing to hear can be put in a way people will listen to.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_JunkAppraiser.degreeDatas.0.d: {PAWN_nameDef} can tell how much food a sack of old goods is worth and drives a sharp bargain.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_GrainMediator.degreeDatas.0.d: {PAWN_nameDef} wants to talk people out of quarrels over food before anyone throws a punch. Some resent the well-meant interference and call it two-faced.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_WoundTender.degreeDatas.0.des: {PAWN_nameDef} has a steady hand with bandages and is rarely distracted by what is happening around {PAWN_objective}.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_EggKeeper.degreeDatas.0.label: fond of children
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_EggKeeper.degreeDatas.0.descr: {PAWN_nameDef} likes to keep the young close and safe, whether they are {PAWN_possessive} own or not. When a young companion goes hungry, falls ill or is downed, {PAWN_pronoun} takes it hard.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_LeanHunger.degreeDatas.0.desc: {PAWN_nameDef} is used to splitting one meal into two and can keep walking on an empty stomach. Even a legendary champion of going hungry would have a hard time keeping up.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_ThickFur.degreeDatas.0.label: cold-tolerant
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_FinePaws.degreeDatas.0.label: deft
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_FinePaws.degreeDatas.0.descri: {PAWN_nameDef} has a sure hand with fine work like mending sacks and threading needles.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_PathScout.degreeDatas.0.label: perceptive
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_PathScout.degreeDatas.0.descr: {PAWN_nameDef} often notices the faintest movement of prey and knows how to stay out of sight while approaching.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_ColumnLead.degreeDatas.0.desc: {PAWN_nameDef} weighs the pros and cons of big decisions, then makes the call with little hesitation. Once the decision is made, {PAWN_nameDef} gets right to work.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_ReliefCook.degreeDatas.0.desc: {PAWN_nameDef} is quick at making hot food for everyone and willing to share even when there is little grain to spare.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_FamineHunter.degreeDatas.0.de: {PAWN_nameDef} approaches prey quietly and is handy at taking it down at close range.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_HungerRage.degreeDatas.0.desc: {PAWN_nameDef} gets irritable when hungry. The emptier the stomach, the harder it is to fight the urge to eat, and the easier it is to get into a quarrel.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_FoodSnatcher.degreeDatas.0.de: {PAWN_nameDef} can hardly bear to watch food pass by. "Food is safest when it is all in your stomach," as {PAWN_nameDef} puts it.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_PlagueDread.degreeDatas.0.des: {PAWN_nameDef} is especially afraid of epidemics. When sick, or when a companion falls ill, {PAWN_pronoun} grows visibly uneasy.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_NightTerrors.degreeDatas.0.de: Sleep does little to refresh {PAWN_nameDef}, and every little sound puts {PAWN_objective} on edge. The more tired, the more anxious.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_FamineSloth.degreeDatas.0.des: {PAWN_nameDef} is a little lazy and rests whenever there is a chance. There is always tomorrow. Tomorrow is for lying down, too.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_GrainGreed.degreeDatas.0.desc: {PAWN_nameDef} always wants a few more mouthfuls when there is grain within reach. The appetite is big, and hunger returns quickly.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_Distrustful.degreeDatas.0.des: {PAWN_nameDef} has a hard time trusting anyone anymore. Even kindness often looks like a trap to {PAWN_objective}.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_WeakFlesh.degreeDatas.0.label: frail
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_WeakFlesh.degreeDatas.0.descr: {PAWN_nameDef} is frail, and a knock leaves a mark.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_WeakGut.degreeDatas.0.label: weak stomach
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_WeakGut.degreeDatas.0.descrip: {PAWN_nameDef} has a weak stomach and gets hungry again soon after a meal.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_Chillblood.degreeDatas.0.desc: {PAWN_nameDef} is very sensitive to cold. A cold wind is enough to make {PAWN_objective} miserable.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_FamineGloom.degreeDatas.0.des: {PAWN_nameDef} has a hard time believing anything good is coming and cracks easily under pressure.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_WailingYoung.degreeDatas.0.de: {PAWN_nameDef} has been quick to cry since childhood. Hunger and cold make the tears come even more easily.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_BitingYoung.degreeDatas.0.des: {PAWN_nameDef} has not learned to share. Someone approaching the food can easily provoke anger, or even the urge to bite.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_AlmsHate.degreeDatas.0.label: too proud for charity
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_AlmsHate.degreeDatas.0.descri: {PAWN_nameDef} sees charity as humiliation and will not bow and give thanks, even after accepting what is offered.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_GrudgeKeeper.degreeDatas.0.de: {PAWN_nameDef} remembers every insult and every stolen possession. At the next meeting, the old grudge comes up first.
{PAWN_nameDef} survived an epidemic once and faces illness with a little more confidence now. Tiredness comes easily, though.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_SiegeDigger.degreeDatas.0.des: {PAWN_nameDef} is good at digging passages and trenches. When bored, even the couch looks worth scratching at.
{PAWN_nameDef} is happy to get into a fight. The fists are ready before an opponent has even finished issuing a challenge.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_AilingMother.degreeDatas.0.de: {PAWN_nameDef} always wants the children somewhere safe. When a young companion goes hungry, falls ill or is downed, {PAWN_pronoun} feels anxious and sad. People often sneer at such a bleeding heart.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_FamilyThief.degreeDatas.0.des: {PAWN_nameDef} puts {PAWN_possessive} own people above the rules. When a young companion goes hungry, falls ill or is downed, {PAWN_pronoun} cannot sit still.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_QuarantineGuard.degreeDatas.0: {PAWN_nameDef} is hard to get close to.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_WrongKin.degreeDatas.0.label: easily lost
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_WrongKin.degreeDatas.0.descri: {PAWN_nameDef} is prone to mistaking a strange door for home and feels let down when that guess is wrong.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_CrowdChild.degreeDatas.0.desc: {PAWN_nameDef} feels more at ease in a crowd. Being alone is boring instead.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_WildHole.degreeDatas.0.label: feral
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_WildHole.degreeDatas.0.descri: {PAWN_nameDef} looks first for cover, then for something edible. Forgotten corners of waste ground feel safer to {PAWN_objective} than a storehouse.
